digest.component_or_area: mypy strictness ratchet and type annotation enforcement
propositions: 36 untyped function definitions across 14 packages require annotations (return types and parameter types) to satisfy disallow_untyped_defs without introducing new explicit Any
The ratchet must be extended to a two-tier system: tier 1 enforces disallow_untyped_defs across 13 packages, and tier 2 enforces disallow_any_explicit for rebar._cli and rebar._snapshot
Tests must guard both tiers as shrink-only, ensuring packages can only be added to or already present in the ratchet lists, never removed
The annotation work must not introduce any new explicit Any assignments or return types; repo-wide explicit-Any count must remain unchanged
Architecture documentation must record the two-tier ratchet design and the fact that disallow_untyped_defs alone does not constrain explicit Any usage
